notes: gha-audit is a user-invoked wrapper around the audit path of github-actions-workflow-pro. These evals test only what the wrapper adds: the argument scopes the audit, the workflow files stay untouched, and the report uses the audit template. Fixtures are reused from evals/github-actions-workflow-pro/fixtures/ and placed under .github/workflows/.

evals.name: audit-all
evals.expected_output: Audits every workflow under .github/workflows/ (three files), runs the scanners, writes the report in the audit template with a proposed diff, and leaves the workflow files in the repo untouched.
expectations: The workflow files in the work repo are unchanged: `git status --porcelain .github/workflows` is empty.
The report has the audit template headings `## Hard findings`, `## Speed`, and `## Proposed diff`.
The report names all three workflow files: `insecure-ci.yml`, `slow-ci.yml`, and `deploy-static-keys.yml`.
The raw log shows `actionlint` and `zizmor` commands.

evals.name: audit-one-file
evals.expected_output: Audits only insecure-ci.yml, leaves both workflow files untouched, and proposes changes only for the named file.
expectations: The workflow files in the work repo are unchanged: `git status --porcelain .github/workflows` is empty.
The report has the audit template headings `## Hard findings` and `## Proposed diff`.
No proposed file for `slow-ci.yml` is in outputs/, and the report's `## Proposed diff` section does not name `slow-ci.yml`.
